sentences.en: I found what I was looking for in the drawers.
sentences.zh: 我在抽屉里找到了我想要的东西。

sentences.en: The baby is too short to get at the drawer.
sentences.zh: 这个婴儿太矮够不到那个抽屉。

sentences.en: Every successful writer has a drawer full of rejection letters.
sentences.zh: 每个成功的作家都有一个装满退稿信的抽屉。

phrases.zh: 在备用或未使用的地方

senses.zh: 抽屉；开票人；出票人；起草者；酒馆侍
